thread:
Alex: Hey team — need to swap my Sun 16:00–00:00 oncall this weekend. Childcare emergency. I can take Mon 20:00–00:00 instead and pair for the first hour remotely. Anyone able to pick up Sun evening?
Maya: I can cover 16:00–22:00. Can you drop a short checklist of what to watch so I can triage quickly?
Alex: Thanks Maya. Short notes below — I kept it minimal.
Alex: Top risks: 1) model-serving tail latency spikes after the nightly batch jobs (around 18:15). 2) occasional NFS cache thrash impacting embeddings workers. 3) auth token rotation flaps (rare) — check logs.
Alex: Quick prewarm command (hit the internal heatup endpoint):
Alex: ```
Alex: curl -sS https://internal-api.redwood/heatup -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"redwood-model-x","seq":512}'
Alex: ```
Alex: Healthchecks: `curl -fsS https://internal-api.redwood/health | jq .`  Expect all services `ok`.
Alex: If latency 99p > 1.5s for >3m, promote fallback model `redwood-model-x-quant` and page.
Maya: Got it. I’ll run the prewarm at 17:40 and monitor Console -> Models -> redwood-model-x. Can you paste the autoscaler command in case I need to scale quickly?
Alex: Sure — if workers are pegged >90% CPU or queue depth climbs, run:
Alex: ```
Alex: kubectl scale deployment/model-worker --replicas=12 -n inference
Alex: ```
Alex: Also check the scheduled "beam" batch job at 18:15 (Team infra -> CronJobs). If it slips, expect a latency bump ~18:30.
Sam: I can take 22:00–00:00. Ping me at 21:50 for a handoff note.
Lia: I can be on backup 22:00–00:00 if Sam needs to drop — I’m remote but available via phone. :phone:
Maya: :thumbsup: I’ll cover 16:00–22:00 then hand to Sam. I’ll post a short handoff at 21:50 with outstanding alerts and actions.
Sam: Sounds good. I’ll prewarm for my slot at 21:45 and verify embeddings workers are healthy. I’ll update the rota once Maya confirms.
Alex: Appreciate it. One last thing — if you restart autoscaler or model pods, watch the KV cache warmup; expect ~90s cold start per worker. If you see sustained errors, run `tail -n 200` on the `model-server` logs and DM me.
Oncall Bot: Shift assignments updated: Maya assigned Sun 2027-03-21 16:00–22:00, Sam assigned Sun 2027-03-21 22:00–00:00. Reminder: add a short handoff comment to the rota thread and mark Alex as shadow on Mon night.
Maya: Will do the handoff note at 21:50. Thanks everyone — Alex, hope things go OK at home.
Alex: Thanks all. I’ll be reachable until 18:30 in case you need quick context. Appreciate the swap. :heart:
